Bash("C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\gh.exe" issue create --title "Bug: Products page links creating duplicate paths (products/products/)" --body "$(cat <<''EOF''
## Description
Links from products.html to product detail pages create incorrect paths with duplicate directory segments.

## Expected Behavior
Link should resolve to: `products/wash-station.html`

## Actual Behavior
Link resolves to: `products/products/wash-station.html` (404 error)

## Examples
- Standard Unit: Expected `products/standard-unit.html`, got `products/products/standard-unit.html`
- Wash Station: Expected `products/wash-station.html`, got `products/products/wash-station.html`
- All product detail page links exhibit this behavior

## Root Cause
The `base_path` variable is not being set correctly for product detail pages in templates. When rendering product links from the products overview page, the base path is being applied twice.

## Files Affected
- `src/templates/components/header.html` - Product dropdown navigation links
- Product page generation logic in `src/generators/html_generator.py`
- Template rendering context setup

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Generate a website with the Clean Restroom Rental Virginia configuration
2. Open the generated products.html page
3. Click any product link in the navigation or page content
4. Observe 404 error with duplicated path segment

## Impact
- All product detail pages are unreachable from navigation
- Breaks user journey for product discovery
- SEO impact from broken internal links

## Related Files
- `output/clients/clean_restroom_rental_va/products.html`
- `src/templates/components/header.html`
- `src/generators/html_generator.py`
EOF
)" --label "bug" --label "content-generator")

Bash("C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\gh.exe" issue create --title "Bug: Incorrect contact link paths in templates" --body "$(cat <<''EOF''
## Description
Some pages contain links to `products/contact.html` which does not exist. The contact page is located at the root level as `contact.html`.

## Expected Behavior
All contact links should point to: `contact.html` (root level)

## Actual Behavior
Some pages link to: `products/contact.html` (404 error)

## Root Cause
Template link generation inconsistency - some templates or link generation logic incorrectly prepends `products/` to the contact page path.

## Files Affected
- Various templates with contact links
- Potentially `src/templates/components/header.html`
- Product page templates that include contact CTAs

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Generate a website with any client configuration
2. Navigate through various pages (especially product pages)
3. Look for contact links in navigation, footer, or CTAs
4. Some will incorrectly point to `products/contact.html`

## Impact
- Broken contact links reduce conversion opportunities
- Inconsistent user experience
- Critical for lead generation and customer inquiries

## Investigation Needed
- Audit all templates for contact link patterns
- Check if `base_path` variable is being incorrectly applied
- Verify contact link generation in header and footer components
- Test from different page depths (root, products/, locations/)

## Related Files
- `src/templates/components/header.html`
- `src/templates/components/footer.html`
- Product page templates
- Location page templates
EOF
)" --label "bug")
Bash("C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\gh.exe" issue close 10 -c "Fixed in commits 78dfee3 and 0b1687e. All contact links now use base_path variable for correct path resolution.")
Bash("C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\gh.exe" issue list --state closed --limit 5)
